style.copy: Warm, emotive and story-led. Three to five short lines, each on its own line, with two or three relevant emoji in the text. End with a soft call to action (visit, save the post, tag a friend). Eight to fifteen hashtags mixing broad and niche tags.
style.visual: Vertical lifestyle photo with one clear subject (a person or a product) framed close and off-centre, warm natural light, rich festive colours, shallow depth of field.

style.copy: Warm, conversational and community-minded, like a local shop talking to its neighbours. Two or three short paragraphs that invite comments and shares, with a question or a reason to tag someone. A few emoji at most. End with a clear call to action (visit, message us, share with a friend). Two to four hashtags.
style.visual: Square, thumb-stopping lifestyle scene with people and warmth: a family, friends or a shopkeeper with the product, centred and inviting, bright natural light.

style.copy: Punchy and conversational. One or two short sentences with a clear hook and a direct call to action. At most one emoji. One or two hashtags.
style.visual: Wide cinematic banner: bold, high-contrast scene with one strong focal point that still reads at small size.
